name: Geomancy: The Stone-Cold Truth
summary: A librarian seeks magical works for the Library in Ironforge. Your contribution can help expand its knowledge.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: The librarian in Ironforge asks you to bring magical works that may benefit the Library. Its collection grows through your efforts, and the librarian welcomes further discoveries.

faq.answer: The librarian asks you to bring magical works that could benefit the Library in Ironforge.
The request comes from the Library in Ironforge.
The librarian says the Library's knowledge expands through your efforts.
